# ADRENL

> ADRENL makes heavyweight graphic tees for people who take the long route. Batch 01 is three designs: RIDGE (black, mountain contours), GARUD (black, mythic eagle) and MARCOS (deep navy, waves and compass).

## Facts
- Batch 01 price: Rs 799 per tee. Planned next-batch price: Rs 999.
- Batch 01 drops 31 October 2026. It is a preorder.
- Planned fabric: heavyweight cotton, 240 GSM target (confirmed on final sample). Made in Tiruppur, India.
- One free size exchange within 7 days of delivery.
- Pictures on the site are design previews of the Batch 01 tees.
